MRI Safety Information
The Zephyr Aneurysm Clip is MR Conditional. A person with the Zephyr Aneurysm Clip may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Zephyr Aneurysm Clip
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 3-Tesla
RF Excitation Circularly Polarized (CP)
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions maximum B1+rms of 1.2 uT; when B1+rms is not displayed, use a whole body SAR of 1.5 W/kg or less
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
